audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx workbooks without runtime dependencies on third-party libraries.

capabilities.text: The library supports creating new workbooks and loading existing .xlsx files through the Workbook class.
capabilities.title: Read and write Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Developers can set font properties, number formats, borders, and other style attributes on individual cells.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting cells

capabilities.text: The library supports adding data validation rules and conditional formatting to worksheet ranges.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Developers can configure page setup, freeze panes, and apply worksheet and workbook protection.
capabilities.title: Page setup and print configuration

capabilities.text: Pictures can be embedded with two-cell anchor positioning and cell comments support author, text, and visibility.
capabilities.title: Embed images and add comments

capabilities.text: ListObjects (Excel tables) and drawing shapes with 38 preset geometries are supported.
capabilities.title: Create and manage Excel tables and shapes

limitations.text: Saving is currently limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx chart types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, and Map) cannot be created programmatically.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and editing of Excel workbooks using a pure Java API without requiring Microsoft Excel or native libraries.
Supports robust loading of potentially corrupted Excel files with repair options and diagnostic reporting.
Provides data validation and conditional formatting capabilities to enforce and highlight data rules in spreadsheets.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java spreadsheet library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks targeting Java 17.

uncertainties: The exact set of unimplemented XML-mapper classes and their impact on metadata preservation is not fully specified.
Whether all 183 public types are fully documented in the Javadoc is not confirmed by the facts.

workflows.name: Create and style workbooks
workflows.text: Developers instantiate a Workbook, add worksheets, write cell values, apply styles, and save to .xlsx format.

workflows.name: Load and repair workbooks
workflows.text: Developers use LoadOptions to enable strict mode toggles and repair features, then inspect diagnostics after loading.

workflows.name: Apply validation and conditional formatting
workflows.text: Developers define data validation rules and conditional formatting conditions on worksheet ranges.
